ident_mandate_title: This URL identifies a mandate-spec v0 mandate
ident_mandate_intro: If you found this address inside a file, that file is a mandate: rules that say what an AI agent may do in a household.
ident_audit_title: This URL identifies a mandate-spec v0 audit log entry
ident_audit_intro: If you found this address inside a file, the file holds entries of an audit log: the record of what agents asked for and what was decided, linked into a hash chain.
ident_checkpoint_title: This URL identifies a mandate-spec v0 audit log checkpoint
ident_checkpoint_intro: This address names the signed statement of a checkpoint: proof that an audit log had a certain entry at a certain position, so later changes are noticed.
